name: Long Wen Ao Xia
source:
You will spend some bedtime moments with your “best friend” that can be either enjoyable or less pleasant. Will you take the medicine?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
睡前，你將與你的「好朋友」共度片刻。這段時光可能很愉快，也可能沒那麼愉快。你要吃藥嗎？
